Maria S: Quick heads-up — we found a libc CVE affecting a small subset of our minimal base images (CVE-2026-0007). I want to coordinate a rebuild that minimizes churn. Proposal: audit-only rollout -> RBAC dry-run for signing -> canary images -> full rebuild. Thoughts?
Rajiv K: Which repos/images are impacted? I ran a quick trivy scan earlier but want the exact list before we schedule.
Maria S: Affected tags: rwinf/base:slim-2025-10 and rwinf/base:gpu-runtime-2025-09 (small percentage of infra uses gpu-runtime). Trivy output snippet: ```
100.0% scan: rwinf/base:slim-2025-10
VULN: CVE-2026-0007 - HIGH - libseccomp
Path: /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6
```
Anna - Security: If we do audit-only first, we should enable immutable audit logs for the signing pipeline and set the image-push route to write-only for 24h. Also want to run an RBAC dry-run for the cosign signer role — check that no service account has broad iam:signer access.
Sam Engine: Re: signing: can we use short-lived KMS-wrapped keys so we don't have to rotate long-lived keys mid-rebuild? Idea: generate ephemeral signing key per canary batch, wrap with KMS, store envelope in audit log. Cosign supports KMS-backed keys but our CI needs an adapter for envelope workflows.
Rajiv K: We currently have a lambda that wraps keys in AWS KMS; it can produce ephemeral keys with TTL. Sam, do you want me to attach the lambda to the pipeline? Any gating around key unwrap permissions?
Sam Engine: Yes please attach. Permission model: pipeline svc acct gets kms:GenerateDataKey* on the specific key alias, but not KMS:Decrypt on the raw material. We should also restrict the unwrap to a short time window and record the ARN in the audit log.
Anna - Security: RBAC checklist for dry-run: 1) Create a test role that mirrors prod cosign role but with only sign on test repo. 2) Enable "kubectl auth can-i --as=role" runs as part of the pipeline to validate. 3) Add an automated alert if any account has iam:SignImage permission outside the expected group.
Maria S: CI change list (short): - toggle audit-only mode flag in image-push - call lambda to mint ephemeral key - cosign sign using KMS envelope - push canary tag to staging registry - run smoke tests against canary runtime - wait 2h for telemetry then decide roll.
ci-bot: pipeline rwinf/base:slim-2025-10-rebuild started by Maria S (job: base-rebuild/6832101234). Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/6832101234
Rajiv K: For rollback, we should keep old image manifests signed and available for 7 days and add a fast-route in router to fallback to signed-manifest if health-check fails. I can add router rule.
Anna - Security: Incident response note: if any canary shows exploitation indicators (SCC audit logs, abnormal outbound connections), trigger incident channel and revoke KMS capability for that pipeline immediately. Also rotate the ephemeral signer policy so it no longer issues new keys.
Sam Engine: One more: during the dry-run RBAC check, run the policy engine with the actual service account tokens (read-only capture) to catch any impersonation gaps. I can add that to the job.
Maria S: Timeline proposal: start audit-only scan tonight (low traffic window), run RBAC dry-run tomorrow morning, canary rebuilds tomorrow afternoon, full rollout Friday evening if telemetry clean. Can everyone ack?
Rajiv K: ack :thumbsup:
Anna - Security: ack. I'll prep the alerts and the KMS kill-switch playbook.
Sam Engine: ack — I'll submit the CI patch and PR to attach the lambda.
ci-bot: job base-rebuild/6832101234: stage=started status=running
Maria S: Great — I'll follow up with a short runbook in GH and drop the links here once done.
